title: Fantasy Football Waiver Wire Week 10: Corey Kiner and Tank Dell step up

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Fantasy Football Waiver Wire Week 10: Corey Kiner and Tank Dell step up
sources.description: Corey Kiner may have stumbled his way into a starting role on the Patriots, while Tank Dell is finally back in the fantasy picture after a long absence. Both players are strong waiver wire options for Week 10.
